title: Payment: websites plan limited v1
description: Owner: payment (owner decision 18 Nov 2026, rule B; Payment payment/plan-limit-downgrade.md). Sent once per plan-limit run that changed something, after the per-website hosting_entitlement_ended / _restored events of that run and in the same transaction. The account's plan allows websites_limit websites online: went_offline lists the websites the run took offline for plan_limit (not deleted), restored the ones it brought back; both in rank order (online the longest first), one of them may be empty. For the owner's email or bell (Notification's Knock workflow). Routing key websites_plan_limited.v1 on Payment's exchange. event_key is unique per run; a consumer uses it to drop a repeat.

plan_code.description: Always set: the plan the account has now, upper case (PLUS, PRO, ULTRA).

websites_limit.description: Websites the plan allows online; always present, null = unlimited.

went_offline.description: project_id of each website taken offline for plan_limit; always present, [] when none.

restored.description: project_id of each website brought back; always present, [] when none.
